data.body:
Verify triage: the 18 failures recorded earlier were an environment error, not repository evidence.

What happened: `make verify` in `.rebar/worktrees/impl-e095` ran under
`/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.rebar/worktrees/impl-0461/.venv/bin/python` — a
*different* worktree's interpreter. That venv's editable install resolves
`rebar.__file__` to impl-0461's `src/rebar/__init__.py`. The whole-tree AST
helpers compute `_REPO_ROOT` from `tests/_tree_scan.py`'s own location
(`tests/_tree_scan.py:13`) but reach `src/rebar` through the imported package,
so `ParsedModule.__init__` called
`PosixPath('.../impl-0461/src/rebar/__init__.py').relative_to('.../impl-e095')`
and raised `ValueError`. Every failure was one of those scans — "appears only
in", "exactly one definition under src", the engine-dir resolution tests.

Measured: impl-e095 has its own `.venv`, and
`.venv/bin/python -c "import rebar; print(rebar.__file__)"` returns
`.../impl-e095/src/rebar/__init__.py`. Re-running all 12 affected modules under
that interpreter: **138 passed in 78s, 0 failures.**

This is the failure mode AGENTS.md's Codex environment rule names — a toolchain
resolved from outside the worktree is an environment error, and the rule applies
to pytest for the same reason it applies to ruff and mypy. The earlier report
of "18 failures" overstated what had been established; it was never checked
which interpreter produced them.

State of the change: one commit, `92ec49b1143`, clean tree, Change-Id
`Ic0d44614099e9bedce25978fa723253aa70f4819`, not yet pushed to Gerrit (queried;
no matching change exists). Remaining before push: a full `make verify` run
under this worktree's own `.venv`, deferred only to avoid CPU contention with
fe94's verify currently running on the same host.

Unverified: whether the full suite is green beyond these 12 modules. Only the
previously-failing set has been re-measured.
